sharedHooks.normalization: Blocked definitions below retain their declared feature sets. Each must adopt the current embedded materialize/credential-reference schema and pass its own acceptance before admission. An implemented shared hook alone does not admit a definition.

allOperationalPlans: matching nonce verifier and intended network vantage
tailscale: current node/tailnet StableID and DNS suffix fingerprint (no native profile ID)
raw HTTPS/MagicDNS prerequisites; CertDomains is provisioning permission only
immutable owned foreground process birth identity and continuity before cleanup
exact selected listener readback and confirmed absence after owned-child exit
lan: client-proven local name/mDNS or explicitly checked client-reachable IP

continuity: Fresh ownershipReceipt binds handleRef, continuityRef and sessionId. Only the owned foreground child is stopped; no provider off/reset. Synthetic receipts never establish real ownership.
probe: Only a matching fresh probeReceipt establishes origin, TLS, instance nonce and required transport behavior. Public accepts remote:true or the originally authorized public-relay class (remote:false, publicDns:true, pinned public IP). Tailnet and LAN require genuine remote:true intended-vantage proof. Local HTTP 200 is insufficient.
